hypothesis: The replication error is associated with sparse support in physical afterstate feature space within a known scenario, rather than an unseen scenario axis.
forbidden_training_data: Every discovery and late row from both sealed evaluation runs.
development_change: Collect additional independent mid/late H3 roots under the existing eight-condition matrix with declared simulator environment seeds, emphasizing distinct afterstates rather than increasing H3 depth.
trajectory_independence_contract: Every collection records its simulator environment seed in both the dataset manifest and replay contract. Different seeds are necessary but not sufficient: model-visible packed and packed-plus-visible afterstate delta signatures must also be unique.

development_collection_result.reason: Different environment seeds produced many byte-distinct teacher rows but repeated the exact model-visible afterstate deltas across runs.

stream_variant_followup.rationale: Change the item stream visible to the policy while holding the simulator seed, scenario matrix, H3 depth, branch factor, and model fixed.

admission_gate.signature: exact concatenation of packed and packed-plus-visible model feature deltas

stream_variant_followup.decision: Run the collection independence audit before any model evaluation. If the gate fails, do not add these rows to training or alter the threshold.

partial_collection_recovery_contract.admission_unit: An individual graph artifact that completed strict root reconstruction and graph validation.
partial_collection_recovery_contract.exclusion_rule: Exclude only missing or failed graphs by workflow step status; never inspect continuation labels to select a graph.
partial_collection_recovery_contract.coverage_rule: The union must include all eight base scenario labels and report every missing variant-scenario cell.
partial_collection_recovery_contract.model_rule: Do not fit or score a model unless graph-level recovery passes coverage and independence gates. A recovered collection does not change the FAIL status of either source workflow run.

excluded: dual-empty step 15: strict root reconstruction mismatch

stream_variant_result.recovery_note: Only graph artifacts that had already completed strict root reconstruction and graph validation were admitted. Labels were not used for admission, and failed workflow runs remain failed.

model_contract.predictor: unchanged consensus of fixed-L2 packed-only and packed-plus-visible no-intercept ridges
model_contract.support_measure: standardized nearest discovery-training afterstate distance for both feature blocks
model_contract.candidate_support_threshold: training-only leave-one-out p95 for each feature block
model_contract.selection_rule: consensus agreement and both support distances at or below threshold

development_acceptance.comparison: must not make more supported-row errors than the unchanged ungated consensus or action geometry

development_model_result.decision: Do not refreeze, confirm, shadow, or move to H5. Test teacher-label stability under wider H3 branching before adding model capacity.

branch_width_followup.hypothesis: Some residual representation errors are caused by B2 optimistic continuation labels being under-sampled, rather than by an insufficient state representation alone.
branch_width_followup.intervention: Rebuild the erroneous stream-variant roots at H3/B3 while holding stream, root snapshot, environment seed, simulator, score axes, and reconstruction tolerance fixed.
branch_width_followup.primary_measure: Whether the directional fill_score_proxy relation for each matched sibling pair agrees between B2 and B3.
branch_width_followup.admission: Every B3 graph must pass the existing strict root reconstruction and graph validation contracts; no tolerance changes and no label-conditioned exclusions.
branch_width_followup.decision_rule: If any tested directional relation changes, treat B2 label stability as unresolved and expand branch-width coverage before model work. If all relations are stable, retain H3/B2 labels and investigate richer state interactions without opening sealed confirmation data.

result.interpretation: Widening B2 to B3 changed which candidate paths survive selection, so three error rows cannot be treated as fixed-label examples under the wider search. The one directly comparable pair retained its lower-afterstate-better relation.

confirmation_contract: After development acceptance, freeze once and evaluate on one later physical matrix generated after the freeze commit. The new confirmation must independently meet at least 75% coverage and zero errors.
stop_conditions: Do not reinterpret either sealed run as confirmation after feature or threshold changes.
Do not increase to H5 until the new independent confirmation passes.
Do not enable shadow or live selection from retrospective or pooled accuracy.
